bandReport.notes:
Seams checked in both directions. p04 (band b1's territory) ends with Q28 complete in both columns — no Directions block is open across the p04/p05 seam, so Q29 starts clean. p09 (band b3's territory) opens with Q54, a fresh standalone question — Q53 ends complete at the foot of p08 and nothing of mine runs overleaf.

Four Directions sets, all four STARTING inside this band, so all members are owned and transcribed here; none runs past p08: D41-42 (reciprocal equation, p07), D43-45 (triangle ABC inscribed in a circle, p07), D46-47 (cloud over a lake, p07), D48-50 (frequency distribution table, p08). No set is truncated at either seam.

No figures anywhere in p05-p08 — the geometry items (Q45, Q53) and the heights-and-distances set (Q46-47) are all stated entirely in words, with no printed diagram. Q48-50 carry a printed data table, transcribed as a GFM pipe table in context.

No misprints found. Two glyph-level checks were made against 3x crops rather than guessed: the D41-42 equation (confirmed \(6x^2 - 25x + 6/x^2 + 25/x + 12 = 0\), i.e. the 6 sits over \(x^2\) and the 25 over \(x\)), and Q52's radical, whose vinculum covers BOTH the 660 and the bracket. Q42's options 62/9 and 82/9 and Q45's 4.5/7.5 cm were also re-read at 3x. An ink blot sits on p08 above the frequency table but obscures no text.

Decimals printed with a raised middle dot (1·46, 4·5, 7·5, 0·5) are transcribed as full stops per the brief.

questions.stem:
Consider the question and two statements given below :

Question : Is \((x^n + y^n)\) divisible by \((x + y)\) ?

Statement-1 : n is a natural number.

Statement-2 : n is an even natural number.

Which one of the following is correct in respect of the question and the statements ?

options.label: A
options.text: Statement-1 alone is sufficient to answer the question

options.label: B
options.text: Statement-2 alone is sufficient to answer the question

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement-1 and Statement-2 are sufficient to answer the question

options.label: D
options.text: Both Statement-1 and Statement-2 are not sufficient to answer the question

questions.stem:
Consider the question and two statements given below :

Let x and y be two real numbers.

Question : Is \(xy > 0\) ?

Statement-1 : \(x^8 y^9 < 0\).

Statement-2 : \(x^9 y^{10} < 0\).

Which one of the following is correct in respect of the question and the statements ?

options.label: A
options.text: Statement-1 alone is sufficient to answer the question

options.label: B
options.text: Statement-2 alone is sufficient to answer the question

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement-1 and Statement-2 are sufficient to answer the question

options.label: D
options.text: Both Statement-1 and Statement-2 are not sufficient to answer the question

flags: Subtopic is a loose fit — the item is about the sign of a product of powers of two reals, not a linear inequality.

questions.stem: In a flight of 2800 km, an aircraft was slowed down due to bad weather. Its average speed for the trip was reduced by 100 km/hr and time of flight increased by 30 minutes. What was the original average speed of the aircraft ?

A person X starts from a place A and another person Y starts simultaneously from another place B which is d km away from A. They walk in the same direction. X walks at an average speed of u km/hr and Y walks at an average speed of v km/hr. How far will X have walked before he overtakes Y ?
flags: Subtopic chosen for the relative-speed overtaking idea; the item involves two walkers, not trains.
